review_notes: Issue #2021 reports nondeterministic compiled output for tuple-unpacking assignments, and merged PR #2022 fixes the ordering in CodeGenerator.pop_assign_tracking.
Retain src/jinja2/compiler.py::CodeGenerator.pop_assign_tracking only; CHANGES.rst and tests/test_compile.py are excluded.
Issue #1467 reports that URL.with_suffix re-encodes the existing path name, and merged PR #1468 changes URL.with_suffix to quote only the new suffix.
Retain yarl/_url.py::URL.with_suffix; CHANGES/1468.bugfix.rst and tests/test_url.py are excluded.
Merged PR #4527 fixes Issue #4526 by guarding is_append_mode against a non-string GzipFile mode; its pre-fix SHA is the head of the earlier append-mode PR #4503.
Ground truth is boto3/compat.py::is_append_mode only; tests are excluded, and the shared file with the earlier Boto3 case is a documented follow-up regression rather than the same fix.
Merged PR #87222 directly fixes Issue #85568 by detecting a service override on non-glibc platforms before getent returns the misleading key-not-found error.
Retain lib/ansible/modules/getent.py::main; integration tests and changelog metadata are excluded.
Merged PR #1509 directly fixes Issue #1479 by resolving default aliases before field_transformer runs; _transform_attrs is the supported pre-fix symbol target.
The production scope is src/attr/_make.py; related alias-state changes remain covered at file level, while docs, changelog, and tests are excluded.
Issue #1159 reproduces a segmentation fault in MultiDict.setdefault when called with one argument, and merged PR #1160 initializes the missing default to Py_None in multidict_setdefault.
Retain multidict/_multidict.c only; changelog and tests are excluded, and C symbol ground truth remains empty.
Issue #3455 reports that HTTP/1.1 100 responses without an optional reason phrase are rejected, and merged PR #3543 accepts both two-part and three-part status lines.
Retain botocore/awsrequest.py::AWSConnection._is_100_continue_status; tests are excluded, and PR #3456 was an earlier unmerged attempt rather than a second case.
Issue #3532 reports that DynamoDB Stubber triggers SSO credential loading before the stubbed call, and merged PR #3535 supplies a null account ID during endpoint resolution.
Retain botocore/stub.py only; changelog and tests are excluded. The fix spans several existing Stubber methods plus a new helper, so expected_symbols remains empty.
Merged PR #1430 directly closes Issue #1429 and changes the foreign-key constraint_name annotation from str to Optional[str] in both public and operation-layer paths.
Both production files and their pre-fix symbols are required; the PR contains no test, documentation, or unrelated production changes.
The first commit of merged PR #1290 records Fixes #1236 and corrects bytes-only header handling across the stream encoding entry point and informational-response utility.
The automatic list is narrowed to src/h2/stream.py and src/h2/utilities.py; the events.py repr guard is an unrelated companion fix and tests plus tox.ini are excluded.
